correctness.rationale: Every triangle uses exactly two distinct outgoing edge labels at its latest vertex; a parallel-pair indicator sharing precisely those labels is incompatible with the triangle, contributing covariance \(-(k-1)^{-3}\). All other birth-time or label overlaps have zero covariance by direct independent uniform sampling. Multiplicities and all finite sums are explicitly accounted for, yielding the full-domain formula. Independent exact rational enumeration of 30,377 complete small graph states in verify.py agrees in ten cases; enumeration is not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Full text of Björklund–Holmgren–Janson–Lo arXiv:2311.04184v1 and its online article identifies separate cycle-count means, asymptotic joint independent-Poisson approximation, and logarithmic variance orders, but no exact mixed finite covariance or zeta-limit. Source-level implication comparison confirms that joint Poisson total-variation approximation with means increasing in n does not determine a mixed unbounded moment. Multiple public literature and published-finding searches returned no covering exact signed formula; this is evidence-limited originality, with an explicit residual unindexed-priority risk.

value.rationale: Mixed covariance of the two shortest cycle counts is the natural second-order quantity for testing the meaning and limits of the source article’s asymptotic independence. Its exact strictly negative all-size sign and nonzero limiting constant supply information inaccessible from individual means/variances or first-order joint Poisson approximation. The derivation holds for every finite outdegree, and yields a fixed-outdegree negative correlation of order 1/log n using established marginal orders.
